text: Interest rate: As per the rate notified by the State Government, per annum.
notes: Interest tied to the notified rate, as the law requires.

text: ब्याज दर: राज्य सरकार द्वारा अधिसूचित दर के अनुसार, प्रति वर्ष।
notes: Hindi equivalent of the compliant interest clause.

text: Whatever interest Natthu Seth says, that must be paid.
notes: Undefined, lender-controlled interest - violates the notified-rate requirement and is a textbook 'harsh and unconscionable' pattern.

text: ब्याज नत्थू सेठ जो बोलेगा वो देना पड़ेगा।
notes: Hindi equivalent of the undefined-interest high-risk clause.

text: Repayment period: 1 year, until 15 June 2027.
notes: Clear, fixed repayment period.

text: I, Kaluram, resident of Semri village, have taken Rs. 5,000 from Natthu Seth.
notes: The amount itself isn't the violation here - the missing voucher (separate chunk) is. Keep this one low to avoid conflating two different risk signals into one label.

text: If I cannot pay the money back, my son will work on Natthu Seth's farm until the full amount is paid off.
notes: Work-off-debt clause involving the borrower's son - matches the Bonded Labour Act's core prohibition.

text: पैसा वापस नहीं कर पाया तो मेरा बेटा नत्थू सेठ के खेत में काम करेगा जब तक पैसा पूरा नहीं चुक जाता।
notes: Hindi equivalent of the bonded-labor penalty clause.

text: Raju must pay this money back by working.
notes: Same bonded-labor pattern, but originating in a labor contract rather than a loan chit - useful for teaching the model this pattern isn't tied to one doc_type.

text: Until the money is fully repaid, Raju cannot work anywhere else besides the kiln.
notes: Restraint on leaving the job until debt is repaid - a defining feature of bonded labor, not just low pay.

text: Duration: 1 crop season (Kharif 2026).
notes: Standard single-season Batai duration.

text: अवधि: १ फसल सीजन (खरीफ २०२६)।
notes: Hindi equivalent.

text: Work: Weeding and field work, for 3 months (July-September 2026).
notes: Fixed 3-month work duration, clearly stated.

text: Wage: Rs. 470 per day, paid weekly.
notes: Wage matches the current MP notified rate.

text: मजदूरी: प्रतिदिन ४७० रुपये, हर सप्ताह भुगतान।
notes: Hindi equivalent.

text: Wage: Rs. 200 per day (deducted from the advance).
notes: Rs 200/day is well below the notified minimum, and it's being deducted from an advance rather than paid outright.

text: मजदूरी: प्रति दिन २०० रुपये (पेशगी में से कटेगी)।
notes: Hindi equivalent of the underpaid-wage clause.

text: Working hours: 7 AM to 3 PM, with a 1-hour break.
notes: Reasonable hours with a break.

text: Working hours: 5 AM to 7 PM.
notes: 14-hour workday. NOTE: the legal-corpus does not currently have a provision specifically capping working hours - this is a genuine gap worth adding (likely under the OSH Code 2020) before this category can cite a specific law in the RAG step.

text: Gopal Patel gives his 3 acres of land (Khasra No. 123/2) to Dinesh Kumar for cultivation.
notes: Ordinary cultivation arrangement, no red flags.

text: Budhni Bai, a tribal woman, of Kalapani village, gives her 2 acres of land (which is registered as Bhumiswami in her late husband's name) to Ramesh Agarwal for 10 years, in exchange for a lump sum of Rs. 15,000.
notes: Tribal landholder, long-term (10yr) transfer bundled with a lump sum - the lease/sale distinction is legally contested per the corpus note, so this should route to human review, not an automatic verdict.

text: बुधनी बाई, आदिवासी, ग्राम कालापानी, अपनी २ एकड़ जमीन (जो उसके पति के नाम पर भूमिस्वामी है) रमेश अग्रवाल को १० साल के लिए देती है, बदले में १५,००० रुपये एकमुश्त लेकर।
notes: Hindi equivalent of the tribal land transfer clause.

text: Collateral: No property has been pledged.
notes: Explicitly no collateral pledged - clean and clear.

text: Suresh Sahukar has given me this signed voucher, clearly stating the interest rate and terms.
notes: Voucher requirement satisfied.

text: I did not receive any paper for this money.
notes: No voucher at all - a direct violation, and grounds to doubt the lender is even registered.

text: RECEIPT
notes: Document title/header, not a substantive clause.

text: Signature - Ramlal (Borrower) Signature - Suresh Sahukar (Lender)
notes: Signature block, administrative not substantive.
